description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` for managing progressive batch processing within a React application. The hook manages UI states such as progress and running status, while the controller handles the logic for processing items in batches asynchronously, respecting UI responsiveness via requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing of items with support for progressive execution using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback. Provides methods to start and cancel processing, and tracks progress.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the progressive expansion controller, managing React state for the process's running status, progress percentage, and processed counts. Offers methods to initiate processing from an array of items and to cancel ongoing processing.
